name: Local model
description: Load Cherry's LM Studio model before a turn so a cold or unloaded Gemma does not fall back to OpenAI.

identifier.description: LM Studio API identifier OpenClaw requests (lmstudio/<identifier>).

modelKey.description: Key passed to lms load. Matches the folder name under ~/.lmstudio/models.

contextLength.description: Context length to load. Must cover Cherry's prompt; 8192 falls back once the transcript exceeds it.

weightsPath.description: GGUF path on the external volume. When this file is missing, the plugin leaves OpenAI fallback in place.

modelLink.description: Symlink LM Studio indexes. Nudged when the catalog still has a stale missing-file error.
